function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The `arm` assignment is not randomised and is strongly confounded by baseline severity. The treatment arm has a much higher proportion of severe cases than the control arm. This means that any comparison of response rates between male and female patients by arm would be biased if not adjusted for severity. I have used direct standardisation to compute the adjusted response rate for each sex within the treatment arm, using the severity distribution in the treatment arm as the standard population. This removes the confounding effect and provides a fair comparison of sex-based response."}
